question: In Esophageal/GEJ trials, bucket overall follow-up months into <12, 12–23, or ≥24.
column_used: Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Overall
final_column: Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Control
raw_output:
```sql
SELECT
  "Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Overall",
  CASE
    WHEN "Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Overall" < '12'
    THEN '<12'
    WHEN "Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Overall" >= '12' AND "Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Overall" <= '23'
    THEN '12–23'
    ELSE '≥24'
  END AS "Follow-up Bucket"
FROM clinical_trials
WHERE
  "Cancer type" = 'Esophageal/GEJ';
```
